title: RxNorm pharmacologic substances also present in CVX (STY = T121, SAB = CVX)
why: Fast: AND of two literal prop sets.

expectedDifferences.reason: tx.fhir.org applies only the STY filter: its first page (e.g. 1000016, 1000086, 1000108) has STY T121 but no CVX atom. In RXNCONSO 03022026, STY = T121 AND SAB = CVX holds for 20 RXCUIs (checked with SQL on the upstream rxnorm_03022026.db: STY alone 26,965, SAB alone 353, both 20). We return the 20.
